name: Neutral architectural corner

original_specification.name: Neutral architectural corner
original_specification.description: Neutral architectural corner is a conceptual setting for furniture; wall and floor finishes. It combines the specified surroundings with independently managed lighting.
original_specification.representation: Procedural 3D studio with separately managed ambient illumination
original_specification.geometry: Two walls and a floor with real junctions; optional ceiling
original_specification.ambient_lighting: Wide-window ambience independent of wall appearance
original_specification.scale_policy: Objects from 0.3 to 4 m; configurable room height; preserve subject dimensions; fit the stage once to an explicit selection, never continuously rescale the CAD model
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural geometry and materials; no AI imagery required
validation: Check horizon and ground contact from multiple cameras.
Check diffuse gray, chrome and thick glass references for clipped reflections and background highlights.

geometry_summary.units: millimetres Z-up in OBJ; metres Y-up in glTF/GLB

radiance.source_owner: HDR owns distant room/task patches; the separate Sun owns solar energy

background.limitations: Not a photograph or native renderer output; finite scene geometry is provided separately.

limitations: Procedural family realization with named contextual components; no claim that every physical detail of the concept has been modeled or validated.
Native glTF import retains geometry and scalar appearances, not arbitrary material extensions or textures.
